section.content: The utility model discloses a biological gene extraction instrument, which relates to the technical field of biological gene extraction instruments and comprises a shell, wherein a gear mechanism is fixedly connected inside the shell and comprises a first motor, an output shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft through a coupler, one end of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first gear, the outer wall of the first gear is in meshed connection with a second gear, one end of the second gear is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, and the outer wall of the threaded rod is in meshed connection with a fixed block. According to the utility model, through the first motor, the first rotating shaft, the first gear, the second gear, the threaded rod and the fixed block, the automatic extraction of samples can be realized, and the plurality of extraction heads can simultaneously extract samples in the plurality of test tubes, so that the problem of low manual extraction efficiency is solved, and the practicability of the device is improved.

本实用新型公开了一种生物基因提取仪器，涉及生物基因提取仪器技术领域，包括外壳，所述外壳的内部固定连接有齿轮机构，所述齿轮机构包括第一电机，所述第一电机的输出轴通过联轴器固定连接有第一转轴，所述第一转轴的一端固定连接有第一齿轮，所述第一齿轮的外壁啮合连接有第二齿轮，所述第二齿轮的一端固定连接有螺纹杆，所述螺纹杆的外壁啮合连接有固定块。本实用新型通过设置的第一电机、第一转轴、第一齿轮、第二齿轮、螺纹杆、固定块，可以实现自动对样品进行提取，且设置的多个提取头，可以同时对多个试管中样品进行提取，解决了人工提取效率慢的问题，使得装置的实用性得到了提升。

Biological gene extraction instrumentTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of biological gene extraction instruments, in particular to a biological gene extraction instrument.

Background

The gene is a DNA fragment with genetic effect, the gene supports the basic structure and performance of life, and stores all information of the processes of race, blood group, inoculation, growth, apoptosis and the like of life, which is an internal factor for determining life health, so the gene has dual properties of materiality and informativeness.

The following problems exist in the prior art:

1. the existing biological gene extraction instrument usually extracts genes manually, the extraction efficiency is too slow, and pollution can occur;

2. the existing biological gene extraction instrument generally extracts a sample directly, may affect the efficiency and accuracy of gene extraction, and is not easy to mix with a reagent.

Disclosure of Invention

The present utility model provides a biological gene extraction apparatus to solve the problems set forth in the background art.

In order to solve the technical problems, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a biological gene extraction instrument, includes the shell, the inside fixedly connected with gear mechanism of shell, gear mechanism includes first motor, the output shaft of first motor passes through shaft coupling fixedly connected with first pivot, the one end fixedly connected with first gear of first pivot, the outer wall meshing of first gear is connected with the second gear, the one end fixedly connected with threaded rod of second gear, the outer wall meshing of threaded rod is connected with the fixed block.

The technical scheme of the utility model is further improved as follows: a gear box is fixedly connected to one side face of the shell, and the first motor, the first rotating shaft, the first gear and the second gear are located in the gear box.

By adopting the technical scheme, the extraction instrument can automatically extract the sample in the test tube.

The technical scheme of the utility model is further improved as follows: one side of the fixed block is fixedly connected with a support frame, and an extraction head is inserted into the support frame.

By adopting the technical scheme, a plurality of extraction heads in the scheme can simultaneously extract a row of test tubes, and the extraction efficiency is faster.

The technical scheme of the utility model is further improved as follows: the inside fixedly connected with stopper of shell, the top sliding connection of stopper has mixing arrangement.

By adopting the technical scheme, the mixing mechanism can be pulled out at will to place the test tube in the scheme, and the operation is more convenient.

The technical scheme of the utility model is further improved as follows: the mixing mechanism comprises a test tube box, a second motor is fixedly connected to the inside of the test tube box, a second rotating shaft is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the second motor through a coupler, a fixing plate is sleeved at one end of the second rotating shaft, a nut is connected to the inside of the second rotating shaft in a threaded manner, and a handle is fixedly connected to the inside of the test tube box.

By adopting the technical scheme, the second motor can rotate rapidly, so that the sample and the reagent are mixed more fully.

The technical scheme of the utility model is further improved as follows: the bottom fixedly connected with spout of test tube box, and the spout card is in the top of stopper.

By adopting the technical scheme, the test tube box is placed more stably and more firmly in the scheme.

The technical scheme of the utility model is further improved as follows: the extraction head forms a communication structure with the threaded rod through the fixed block, the first motor, the first gear, the second gear.

By adopting the technical scheme, the automatic operation can be realized through the cooperation between the gears in the scheme, and the use is convenient.

By adopting the technical scheme, compared with the prior art, the utility model has the following technical progress:

1. the utility model provides a biological gene extraction instrument, which can automatically extract samples through a first motor, a first rotating shaft, a first gear, a second gear, a threaded rod and a fixed block, and a plurality of extraction heads are arranged to extract samples in a plurality of test tubes at the same time, so that the problem of low manual extraction efficiency is solved, and the practicability of the device is improved.

2. The utility model provides a biological gene extraction instrument, which can rotationally mix samples in a test tube through a test tube box, a second motor, a second rotating shaft, a fixed plate, a nut, a handle, a sliding groove and a limiting block, solves the problems of low efficiency and low accuracy caused by non-mixing of reagents and the samples, and improves the extraction efficiency of the device.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of the overall structure of the present utility model;

FIG. 2 is a schematic diagram of a gear structure according to the present utility model;

FIG. 3 is a schematic diagram of a hybrid architecture of the present utility model;

fig. 4 is a cross-sectional view of the present utility model.

In the figure: 1. a housing; 2. a gear mechanism; 201. a first motor; 202. a first rotating shaft; 203. a first gear; 204. a second gear; 205 threaded rod; 206. a fixed block; 3. a gear box; 4. a support frame; 5. an extraction head; 6. a mixing mechanism; 601. a test tube box; 602. a second motor; 603. a second rotating shaft; 604. a fixing plate; 605. a nut; 606. a handle; 607. a chute; 7. and a limiting block.

Detailed Description

The utility model is further illustrated by the following examples:

example 1

As shown in fig. 1-4, the utility model provides a biological gene extraction instrument, which comprises a housing 1, wherein a gear mechanism 2 is fixedly connected inside the housing 1, the gear mechanism 2 comprises a first motor 201, an output shaft of the first motor 201 is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft 202 through a coupler, one end of the first rotating shaft 202 is fixedly connected with a first gear 203, the outer wall of the first gear 203 is in meshed connection with a second gear 204, one end of the second gear 204 is fixedly connected with a threaded rod 205, and the outer wall of the threaded rod 205 is in meshed connection with a fixed block 206.

In this embodiment, through the first motor 201, first pivot 202, first gear 203, the second gear 204, threaded rod 205, fixed block 206 of setting, can realize extracting the sample voluntarily, and a plurality of extraction heads 5 of setting can draw the sample in a plurality of test tubes simultaneously, the slow problem of manual extraction efficiency has been solved, make the practicality of device obtain promoting, through the test tube box 601 of setting, the second motor 602, the second pivot 603, fixed plate 604, nut 605, handle 606, spout 607, stopper 7, can carry out rotatory mixing to the sample in the test tube, the inefficiency that reagent and sample do not mix and produce has been solved, the problem of accuracy is not high, the extraction efficiency of device has been improved.

Example 2

As shown in fig. 1-4, on the basis of embodiment 1, the present utility model provides a technical solution: preferably, a side surface of the shell 1 is fixedly connected with the gear box 3, the first motor 201, the first rotating shaft 202, the first gear 203 and the second gear 204 are located in the gear box 3, a side surface of the fixed block 206 is fixedly connected with the support frame 4, the extraction head 5 is inserted into the support frame 4, the limit block 7 is fixedly connected with the inside of the shell 1, and the top of the limit block 7 is slidably connected with the mixing mechanism 6.

In this embodiment, the make extraction instrument in this scheme can realize extracting the sample in the test tube automatically, and a plurality of extraction heads 5 in this scheme can draw a row of test tube simultaneously, and extraction efficiency is faster, and the test tube is placed in the feasible mixed mechanism 6 of making in this scheme can pull out at will, and the operation is more convenient.

Example 3

As shown in fig. 1-4, on the basis of embodiment 1 and embodiment 2, the present utility model provides a technical solution: preferably, the mixing mechanism 6 comprises a test tube box 601, a second motor 602 is fixedly connected to the inside of the test tube box 601, a second rotating shaft 603 is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the second motor 602 through a coupler, a fixing plate 604 is sleeved at one end of the second rotating shaft 603, a nut 605 is connected to the inner thread of the second rotating shaft 603, a handle 606 is fixedly connected to the inside of the test tube box 601, a sliding groove 607 is fixedly connected to the bottom of the test tube box 601, the sliding groove 607 is clamped above a limiting block 7, and the extraction head 5 forms a communication structure with the threaded rod 205 through a fixing block 206, the first motor 201, the first gear 203 and the second gear 204.

In this embodiment, can be along with the quick rotation of second motor 602 in this scheme for sample and reagent mix more abundant, and the messenger test tube box 601 in this scheme is placed more stably, and is more firm, and cooperation through the gear in this scheme can realize automatic operation, facilitates the use.

The working principle of the biological gene extraction instrument is specifically described below.

In use, as shown in fig. 1-4, the test tube cartridge 601 is opened by the handle 606, the sample test tube is inserted into the fixing plate 604, the sample and the reagent in the test tube are mixed by the rotation of the second motor 602, the rotation of the first motor 201 drives the rotation of the first gear 203, thereby driving the rotation of the second gear 204, and then driving the threaded rod 205 to rotate, so that the fixing block 206 drives the support frame 4 and the extraction head 5 to perform mobile extraction.

The foregoing utility model has been generally described in great detail, but it will be apparent to those skilled in the art that modifications and improvements can be made thereto. Accordingly, it is intended to cover modifications or improvements within the spirit of the inventive concepts.
